items.title: Irwin Leclere Interview, 1970-04-14
items.q: Well, Sam was the manager of the Triangle Publishing Company. Klessy owned it. But Sam Rosenbaum was the manager.

ctx.x: That's grand, you folks have a wonderful collection. Thank you. Everything is possible. We try to do our best. It doesn't look like you missed anything. Well, we did. And look, even got Sam Rosenbaum's collection, manuscript copies of sheet music. Yeah. Isn't that something?

Yeah, I love your tune so much. That's why, and I like Triangle Jazz Blues, all those. I noticed there's no repeats on it, you just played each string once. Yeah, yeah. And that was it, straight down, huh?
